column1: # Skills taken from an upstream repository, pinned to the upstream commit they
# have been reviewed through. A skill with local changes is committed under
# llm/skills/; scripts/llm.sh clones any other into the ghq root, checks out the
# pinned commit and symlinks it into llm/skills/. It also prints a compare URL
# when upstream moves past the pin; moving the pin is a manual step.
